test_title: PYST 11: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

ADV, EBX, IXZ, ORB, ?
solution:
According to the English dictionary and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

**First letter is an vowel and it shifts to next vowel.**

**Second alphabet is decreased by +2 of the previous alphabet.**

Third alphabet is increased by 2 positional values.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1cffefcd95e810c6ebe328353579e6e2b3e408cdeb1f76bb95785d7ad54fd51.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is Option 3.
